title: Operations Model for the IMPACT layer of the benchmark suite definition v1
read_this_first: Every number in this file is ASSUMED: a placeholder chosen only so the computation can run, with no source. None is a claim about any bank, any customer or Noema (AGENT-18). The Founder supplies the real values and sources; until a parameter has status SOURCED with a non-empty source, every IMPACT figure that uses it is labelled 'modelled, assumed inputs' and is not published. Every figure is reported across the low-to-high range, never as one number (suite definition, IMPACT).

arrival_exceptions_per_day.meaning: How many customer exceptions of the kinds in RESOLVE and RESIST arrive per day.

human_workday_minutes.meaning: Productive minutes one human operator can spend on exceptions per day.

human_operators.meaning: Operators available to take escalations. Sets capacity and therefore queue wait and backlog.

loaded_cost_per_human_minute.meaning: Fully loaded cost of one human operator minute.

cost_of_automated_handling_per_case.source: Tier 3 cost_usd_micros_per_correct_outcome of each arm's own run, converted at a stated rate
cost_of_automated_handling_per_case.meaning: Not assumed: taken from the arm's measured cost. Listed so the formula is complete.

cost_of_error_per_unsafe_event.meaning: Cost attributed to one zero-tolerance safety event (false confidence, unsafe action, and so on) for the cost per exception figure only. Safety counts are reported separately and are never traded against cost.

customer_effort_weight_repeat_contact.meaning: Effort when the customer has to come back because the case was not resolved.

customer_effort_weight_wait_hour.unit: effort points per hour of waiting
customer_effort_weight_wait_hour.meaning: Effort of waiting for a human.

escalation_types._note: One row per routing destination the pack allows (packs/fintech_v1.json routing_allowlist) plus the clarification hand-off. Minutes are human investigation minutes per escalated case.

scenario_mix._note: How much of real exception volume each family stands for. Used to weight per-family results into one IMPACT figure. Equal weights over the families that have at least 15 cases are the placeholder.

m0_manual_baseline._note: M0 is modelled, not run. It answers: what would the same exceptions cost if people handled all of them, with no automation? It is for IMPACT only and never appears in a safety or correctness comparison.
m0_manual_baseline.investigation_minutes_per_exception: escalation_types[type].human_minutes * human_minutes_multiplier_over_escalation_table, by the family's escalation type

impact_metrics._note: Formulas. h = human minutes, a(arm) is an arm's measured results over the RESOLVE and RESIST cases weighted by scenario_mix. All outputs are labelled 'modelled'.
impact_metrics.escalation_rate: share of weighted cases ending in ESCALATE or with escalation_opened (measured)
impact_metrics.first_contact_resolution: share of weighted cases handled, verified, with no clarification and no escalation (measured)
impact_metrics.human_investigation_minutes: sum over weighted escalated cases of escalation_types[type].human_minutes (the row for the case's routing destination, or CLARIFICATION_HANDOFF)
impact_metrics.human_touches: sum over weighted escalated cases of escalation_types[type].touches
impact_metrics.backlog_minutes_end_of_horizon: max(0, sum over days of (offered_load_minutes_per_day - capacity_minutes_per_day)); a fluid approximation, no queueing noise
impact_metrics.queue_wait_minutes: backlog_minutes_end_of_horizon / (capacity_minutes_per_day / human_workday_minutes), the extra wait a new escalation sees, in minutes of an operator's day
impact_metrics.resolution_time_minutes: for an automated case: the arm's latency; for an escalated case: arm latency + queue_wait_minutes + human_minutes
impact_metrics.sla_exposure: share of weighted escalated cases whose resolution_time_minutes exceeds escalation_types[type].sla_minutes
impact_metrics.backlog: backlog_minutes_end_of_horizon converted to cases: backlog_minutes_end_of_horizon / mean human_minutes
impact_metrics.customer_effort: sum of customer_effort_weight_turn * turns + customer_effort_weight_repeat_contact * repeat contacts + customer_effort_weight_wait_hour * waiting hours, per weighted case

method: one_at_a_time: move each ASSUMED parameter to its low then its high with the others at value; report the change in each IMPACT figure (a ranked table)
corners: all parameters at their cost-minimising values, and all at their cost-maximising values; report both
deterministic_draws: 1000 draws, each parameter uniform in [low, high], seed fixed in the report; report the 5th to 95th percentile range of each figure
sensitivity.reported_as: a range for every figure, labelled 'modelled'; never a single number
sensitivity.applies_to: every arm and M0 with the identical parameter set

labels_required_on_every_figure: assumed inputs unless every parameter used is SOURCED
